hypotheses.title: Unauthenticated Access to Sensitive Data
hypotheses.description: An attacker may be able to access sensitive data without proper authentication.
hypotheses.recommendedNextStep: Implement authentication and authorization mechanisms for the API Gateway.

hypotheses.title: Insufficient Input Validation
